meta.notes: The app names it "TANCHJIM-FOLA". USB 0x31b2:0x1123 (KT Micro's vendor id); the app compares the name as a substring, this profile exactly. HID: reports 0x4B (75) and 0x54 (84) in and out, 10 bytes, and input report 1, 1 byte, in one consumer-control collection; the app uses only 0x4B. An earphone with a USB-C DSP cable. The app's "virtual channel" settings for it are its own 5-band presets, written as an ordinary EQ.
